description: Non-material amendment: 1.Addition of an external access door to the bike store. 2.Minor alteration to the layout of the plant acoustic screening enclosure. 3.Additional external doors to the Level 6 external amenity space. 4.Addition of roofing to the plant enclosures. 5.Mounting of smoke extractors at roof level in a horizontal configuration. 6.Relocation of one strip of glazed units from one bay section to an adjacent bay section. 7.Change in specification of one strip of glazed units. 8.Slight increase in the depth of the band at first floor slab level.of full planning permission application reference 22/3965 dated 23/02/2024 for Demolition of existing buildings and construction of two new buildings to provide commercial floorspace (Use Class: E) and student accommodation bedspaces (Use Class: Sui Generis), associated access and highways works, amenity space, cycle parking spaces, disabled car parking spaces and refuse/recycling stores. Subject to a legal agreement under Section 106 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended) dated 23rd of February 2024.
